描述_EN: the presence of this and other similar figurines in tombs establishes that the chinese imperial family had adopted the pursuits of the neighbouring steppe peoples, including hunting with dogs. carvings dating from the sumerian empire (7000-6000 bc) have also been identified as saluqi. the hounds were also known in india from the time of alexander the great and in china from these figurines in 8th-century tombs. some people believe that the saluqi is the earliest domesticated dog. it is known from about 2100 bc in ancient egypt where these revered dogs were sometimes found mummified in royal tombs. this unglazed earthenware figure represents a saluqi, a coursing hound.
描述_ZN: 墓葬中出现的这个和其他类似的雕像证明了中国皇室已经采用了邻近草原民族的追求，包括用狗打猎。 苏美尔帝国（公元前7000-6000年）的雕刻也被认定为萨鲁奇。 印度亚历山大大帝时期的猎犬和中国8世纪古墓中的这些小雕像也是已知的。 有些人认为萨鲁奇是最早的驯化狗。 在公元前2100年左右的古埃及，这些受人尊敬的狗有时会在皇室墓穴中被发现制成木乃伊。 这个无釉陶俑表现的是一只萨鲁奇，一只猎犬。
